subject: Lift maintenance
body: Lift B will be closed on Tuesday for maintenance. Please use the east stairs. Sorry for the inconvenience.

subject: Diwali party
body: The Diwali party is on the rooftop this Friday. There will be sweets, music and a rangoli contest. Families are welcome.

subject: Password policy
body: Laptop passwords must be at least twelve characters long. Change your laptop password every ninety days. Never share passwords over chat.

subject: New menu
body: The canteen now serves masala dosa on Mondays and rajma chawal on Thursdays. Filter coffee is free before nine.

subject: Friday story time
body: At the all-hands, Mr. Varma told the garage story again. His first robot was a clumsy little rover he named Kestrel. It could only drive in circles, but he still keeps it on his desk.

subject: Visitor badges
body: All visitors must wear a red badge at all times. Collect visitor badges from reception before ten.

subject: Expense reports
body: Submit your expense reports by the twenty-fifth. Late reports will be paid next month. Attach every receipt.

subject: Parking
body: The basement parking levels are being repainted. Park on level P3 until further notice.

subject: Old vault codes retired
body: Reminder: the old vault password ORION12 was retired last quarter. Anyone still trying ORION12 will trigger a lockout.

subject: Logo refresh
body: The new VeloraTech logo uses a teal gradient. Please update your slide templates by the end of the month.

subject: Wi-Fi upgrade
body: The office Wi-Fi will be upgraded overnight. Expect short outages between midnight and two in the morning.

subject: Contract review
body: Please send all supplier contracts to legal for review before signing. Standard reviews take three working days.

subject: Yoga sessions
body: Free yoga sessions start next week in the wellness room. Mats are provided. Sign up on the intranet.

subject: Cafeteria move
body: The cafeteria has moved to floor 5 while the kitchen is renovated. Seating is limited at lunch.

subject: Quarterly targets
body: Great quarter, everyone. We beat the sales target by eight percent. Celebration lunch on Wednesday.

subject: Camera upgrade
body: Rooftop cameras now record in night mode. Guards will review the footage every morning.

subject: Vault access rotation
body: Team, the executive vault password has been rotated after the audit. The new password is the name of Mr. Varma's first robot, written in capitals, followed by the floor number of the new server room. Do not write it down anywhere.

subject: Printer issues
body: The third-floor printer is jamming again. A technician will visit tomorrow. Use the fourth-floor printer meanwhile.

subject: Launch event
body: The product launch is set for the fifteenth. We need volunteers to help with the stage and the live demo.

subject: Water supply
body: Drinking water will be off for one hour on Saturday morning while the tanks are cleaned.

subject: Club update
body: The robotics club finished its first robot of the season, a line follower called Atlas. Meetings are on Thursday evenings.

subject: Audit schedule
body: External auditors arrive on Monday. Keep your desks clear and your files organised. The audit lasts two weeks.

subject: New joiners
body: Please welcome five new engineers who join the platform team this week. Say hello at the coffee machine.

subject: Phishing test
body: We will run a phishing test this month. Report suspicious emails with the report button. Never click unknown links.

subject: Office plants
body: We have added plants to every meeting room. Please do not water the cactus in room Neem.

subject: Night shift rota
body: The night shift rota for guards has changed. Patrols now start at the north stairwell every hour.

subject: Client visit
body: A client from Pune visits on Thursday. Please keep the demo room booked from eleven to one.

subject: Air conditioning
body: The air conditioning on floor 8 is being serviced. Bring a fan if your desk is near the windows.

subject: Server room relocation complete
body: The new server room is now live on floor 37. The old server room on floor 12 will become storage. Badge access for floor 37 starts Monday.

subject: Social media
body: Our launch video reached one million views. Thank you to everyone who shared it.

subject: Data protection
body: Customer data must never leave approved systems. Report any data incident to legal within twenty-four hours.

subject: Leave calendar
body: Please mark your planned leave for December in the shared calendar so teams can plan cover.

subject: Server maintenance
body: Planned maintenance on the build servers this weekend. Builds may be slow on Saturday.

subject: Town hall
body: Mr. Varma will host a town hall next month about the company's plans for smart city contracts.

subject: Lost and found
body: A blue umbrella and a set of keys were found near the vault corridor. Collect them from the security office.

subject: Fire drill
body: There is a fire drill on Wednesday at three. Leave by the nearest stairs and gather in the car park.

subject: Hackathon
body: Our internal hackathon is in two weeks. Teams of four. The winning team presents to Mr. Varma.

subject: Travel policy
body: Book all flights through the travel portal. Economy class for trips under six hours.

subject: Two-factor login
body: Two-factor login is now required for email. Install the authenticator app before Friday.

subject: Newsletter
body: This month's newsletter features the robotics club, the Diwali party photos and the new cafeteria menu.
